schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (72 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-74 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-25, [match block, 9 rows], 27-73; q74 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 41, average 10, difficult 22, untagged 1.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 33 (heading, LO, q1-3) 34-38; A pdf 137 (heading, keys 1-13) 138-142.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-15; s3 T/F q16-25; s4 '26. Match the following with appropriate answers (easy)' q26 (9 rows); s5 one mark q27-41 vsa; s6 two marks q42-55 sa; s7 three marks q56-64 sa; s8 four marks q65-74 la.
q49 'How does vitamin D help our body?' prints no tag -> 'no difficulty tag'.

Key forms: one-line prose keys stored verbatim; bullet keys one step per bullet; sub-bullets printed 'o   …' under a bullet (q71, q73) are their own steps, the bullet they hang from ('Preservation methods:', 'For outing, carry:') is a heading, not a step; key heads 'Food categories:', 'Food preservation:', 'Food Pyramid: (Draw and label)', '(Draw and explain)' are headings, not steps (addendum §5.2).
q57 'Draw a pyramid diagram…' and q68 'Draw and explain…': keys print text only (the drawing is not printed) — stored as printed; q74 'Draw a picture of a cow' -> no key -> 'no answer printed'.
q60 stem prints its tag mid-line before the item list ('… food items. (Difficult) Rice Bean Butter Palak egg Fruits') — tag removed, item list kept.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_08.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.

A (vitamins/ animals): a) Vitamin B; b) Vitamin A; e) Vitamin D; d) Vitamin C; e) Butterfly; f) Tiger; (r) Hawk; a) Crane; (a) Elephant
